title: Complete human verification for 10,000 V-Bucks
scenario: A video promises 10,000 free V-Bucks if you enter your username and complete a 'human verification' survey, which asks for your email password to confirm you're not a bot.

answers.A: Close it. Free item generators for paid in-game currency don't exist, and no verification step ever needs a password.
answers.B: Enter the username only, and skip the password part.
answers.C: Complete the whole survey, including the password, to get the reward.

explanation: There is no legitimate way to generate paid in-game currency for free. The 'verification' step exists purely to collect your login and personal details.
proTip: Anything free that needs your password is only free for the person collecting it.
